documents.text: Airways International was an airline based in Anchorage, Alaska. Airways International was founded in 1979 and began operations around 1984. The airline ceased operations in 1999. The carrier's primary business focus was flights within southern Florida and to the Bahamas. Airways International also operated charter flights. In 1985, Airways began service to the Bahamas with Convair 580 aircraft. Throughout its history, Airways operated a fleet of Shorts 330, Convair 580, Cessna 402, Convair 440, and Piper Aztec aircraft. In 1992, the airline added the Shorts 330 to its fleet and operated. As of 1992, there were 30 aircraft.
